# LWPT

> A Pascal toolkit for dependency management (including dependency updates and
> a self-hosted signed package registry), builds, tests, CLI libraries,
> formatting, health, duplication, run tasks, lifecycle hooks, repair, and
> agent sync.

Use the consumer guide when creating a project with LWPT. The contributor guide
and AGENTS.md govern changes to LWPT itself. Run `lwpt --help` for the installed
command set and `lwpt <command> --help` for options. The consumer example pins
released packages; main-branch references may describe newer behavior.

## Start here

- [Consumer guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/consumer-guide.md): Homebrew installation, a complete CLI and native test, and capability selection.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/README.md): Command overview and manifest examples.
- [Documentation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/README.md): Canonical topic references.

## Capabilities

- [Registry dependencies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/adr/0051-registry-dependency-sources.md): Consume `registry:` dependencies from a pinned, signed registry origin.
- [Registry deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/registry-deployment.md): Run a registry origin or mirror and publish packages with `lwpt registry`.
- [Dependency updates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/adr/0039-outdated-update-subcommands.md): `lwpt outdated` and `lwpt update` for git-host dependencies.
- [Recovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/quick-start.md#common-errors): `lwpt repair` recovers interrupted installs and residue and upgrades a v3 lockfile.
- [Build system](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/build-system.md): Build entries and lifecycle integration.
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/testing.md): Native test programs, selectors, and compiled-test reuse.
- [Code style](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/code-style.md): Formatter behavior and source scope.
- [Health](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/health.md): Complexity thresholds and reports.
- [Tooling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/tooling.md): Duplication checks and tool configuration.
- [Run tasks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/adr/0013-run-subcommand-and-build-rename.md): Manifest commands for project-specific work.
- [Lifecycle hooks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/adr/0011-build-lifecycle-hooks.md): Hook commands and staleness checks.
- [Agent reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/adr/0027-agents-subcommand.md): Generate and check project command documentation.
- [CLI options](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/packages/cli/source/CLI.Options.pas): Application argument types.
- [CLI subcommands](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/packages/cli/source/CLI.Subcommands.pas): Command registration, dispatch, and help.

## Optional

- [Contributor setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/quick-start.md): Build and test LWPT itself from source.
- [Contributor instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/AGENTS.md): Repository-specific constraints.
- [Package architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frostney/lwpt/main/docs/packages.md): Package ownership and migration history.
